pages.title: Distributions
pages.text: $(thing)Distributions$()$(br2)Add up enough small independent chances and their total always spreads into the same bell-shaped curve, whatever the chances were. Unlocks the Normal Distribution Crystal.

$(thing)Insight$(): 30$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Combinatorics, Calculus.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Dice Set.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Add up many small independent random pushes and the total spreads into a bell-shaped curve with centre μ and width σ. Write the height f of that curve at the value x.
